title: SKILL.md: the instruction set
text: Folder Claude reads before it works. This one is called customer pulse. Inside is one file skill. MD the full instruction set written in plain language with no hidden code underneath it. Claude reads that file then acts on what it says. The file is the program. The instructions live in a step section.

title: How it runs: one step at a time
text: Claude reads each step in order and carries it out linear one step after another. No branching unless a step itself says to branch. Because customer pulse is a written spec, Claude only does what that file says, the same steps in the same order every time it runs.

title: The limit is the file
